**Frog urogenital system — the NEB comparison**

| Feature | Male frog | Female frog |
|---|---|---|
| Gonads | Testes (yellow, ovoid) near kidneys | Ovaries (lobed, seasonal size) |
| Duct system | Vasa efferentia → kidney → Bidder's canal → urinogenital duct → cloaca | Oviducts independent of kidneys → ovisac → cloaca |
| Kidney link | Sperm and urine share the final duct | Eggs and urine separate until cloaca |
| Seasonal change | Vocal sacs + nuptial pads in breeding season | Ovaries swell enormously before monsoon |
| Fertilisation | External, during amplexus | External, eggs in jelly strings |
